name: arith_sum_lcm
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Nat.lcm k n = n * (1 + ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d * d.totient)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Nat.lcm k n = n * (1 + ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d * d.totient)
informal: Σ_{k=1}^n lcm(k,n) = (n/2)(1 + Σ_{d|n} dφ(d)) — group k by g = gcd(k,n): lcm = n·(k/g) with k/g a totative of d = n/g; Uses Mathlib2.nt2_two_mul_sum_coprime_eq_mul_totient at the inner step for every d > 1 (twice the totative sum is dφ(d)); the d = 1 term contributes the extra 1.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, k.lcm n = n * (1 + ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d * d.totient)
